description: Figure 16c (“MMLU Pro confidence vs. accuracy”) is a line plot showing how accuracy varies across bins of **Initial Confidence** for three series labeled **Final Accuracy**, **Δ Accuracy**, and **Initial Accuracy**. The x-axis is labeled **Initial Confidence** on a linear scale, spanning approximately **0.01 to 0.99** with tick labels at about **0.01, 0.09, 0.17, 0.25, 0.33, 0.41, 0.49, 0.57, 0.65, 0.73, 0.81, 0.89, 0.99**. The y-axis is labeled **Accuracy** on a linear scale from **0.0 to 1.0**, with regularly spaced ticks at **0.2** intervals. The **Final Accuracy** line is **blue** with **plus (+) markers** and a **solid** line, staying high across the range (around **0.95** near the leftmost bin) and remaining close to the upper part of the axis through to the rightmost bin (around **0.93–0.95**), with small oscillations. The **Δ Accuracy** line is **orange** with **plus (+) markers** and a **dashed** line, starting around **0.45** at the leftmost bin and generally trending downward across the x-axis, reaching near **0.0** at the rightmost bin, with minor fluctuations between bins. The **Initial Accuracy** line is **green** with **plus (+) markers** and a **dashed** line, beginning around **0.50** at the leftmost bin and gradually increasing across the confidence bins, ending near **0.90–0.95** at the rightmost bin; all three series include vertical error bars at each x-position.
